title: Later-Night Returns of Free Night Awards on Reservations Cancelled After the Deadline
content:
When a reservation is cancelled after its deadline, every award paying a night after its first night is returned to the member's account, and its return record states the protected rebooking price: the points price at which that returned night stays protected if the member rebooks it.

This rule returns only a later-night Free Night Award whose expiry date has not passed on the day of the return; one whose expiry date has passed expires under the release and expiry terms of the Free Night Awards and is not returned under this rule.

The return record of a later-night award on a reservation cancelled after its deadline states the protected rebooking price, as the Free Night Awards terms work it out, rather than repeating the price recorded on the hold. The return record of a later-night award on a reservation cancelled after its deadline carries the reason that the reservation was cancelled after its deadline, as the loss record of its first-night award does.

## When the return is booked

A later-night award of a reservation cancelled after its deadline is not returned until the award paying that reservation's first night stands forfeited with its loss record in its history.

Put the other way, the same rule: while the award on that reservation's first night does not yet stand forfeited with a loss record in its history, no later-night award of the reservation is returned.

## Situation of use and capability

`release_later_night_award_2a59ee43` returns to the member's account a Free Night Award that paid a night after the first night of a reservation cancelled after its cancellation deadline. It puts one award back: the award's status becomes issued again, the award keeps its reservation and night as history and keeps its original expiry date, and one return entry is added to the award's history naming the award, its reservation and night, the protected rebooking price given in the call, no top-off points, the current date and the reason that the reservation was cancelled after its deadline. Afterwards the award is usable again in the member's account and the return appears in its history.

## How it is invoked

This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `release_later_night_award_2a59ee43`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `certificate_id` | The reference number of the Free Night Award being returned, read from the member's award records | Identifier |
| `reservation_id` | The reference number of the cancelled reservation the award comes back from, read from the member's reservation records | Identifier |
| `award_points_price` | The protected rebooking price the return entry states | Integer points: whole points, no decimals, never negative |

## Return

On success: a text rendering of a dictionary with `activity_id` (the reference number of the new return entry), `certificate_id` (the award returned), `status` (always `issued` on success), `activity_date` (the date of the return, YYYY-MM-DD) and `award_points_price` (the integer points recorded on the return entry). Receiving this dictionary means the award is back in the member's account.
